payload.rebuttal: fixed: send_back took seven explicit parameters instead of the single-argument closure the spec and SA-0327's forward reference require, because I had restructured it to dodge a ruff B023 warning. I restored send_back(reason) as a true closure reading group, prompt, session, origin_task_id, spent and already_sent_back from write_follow_ups' enclosing scope, matching the exact call shape SA-0327 depends on. Every captured name is read within the same loop pass that set it, never a later one, so B023 is a false positive here; I silenced it line by line with # noqa: B023, the same narrow, explained pattern already used in runtime.py and revert.py.
